checks.result: TestClient stalled in a minimal Windows asyncio Proactor socketpair initialization; interrupted without claiming pass

supported_claims: The bounded strict JSON parser rejects duplicate and non-ASCII/confusable schema keys, excessive depth, invalid Unicode surrogates and non-finite numeric values; valid Unicode values remain unchanged.
The request-limit middleware parses JSON through the strict parser and bounds JSON request bodies.
limitations: The passing checks exercise parser helpers, not the HTTP request middleware end to end.
Missing-field validation, malformed HTTP body handling, and actual-size rejection without Content-Length need rerun on a working ASGI test environment.
